claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Palonosetron is a potent, high-affinity 5-HT3 receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM for 5 days it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines, with any weak antiproliferative effect attributable to off-target cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress rather than receptor-mediated killing.
